fields.description: Which kind of document this range covers. The master's ORDER determines the payload's doc_num, so the two must stay in step.
First serial number in the range. Letters, digits, hyphen and slash; must contain at least one character that is not a zero, so an all-zero range is rejected.
Last serial number in the range. Same rule as the first. Nothing checks that it actually follows the 'from' value, or that the count matches the range.
How many documents the range covers. Whole numbers only — no decimal point, and no sign.
How many of them were cancelled. Whole numbers only, and never more than the total.

derivation_notes.gstr1.document_number: doc_num is the 1-based index of the nature of document within the fixed twelve-entry list in masters/document-types.json. The reference hardcodes the same list in its own mapping, so the order is part of the interface, not a presentation choice.
derivation_notes.gstr1.record_serial: num counts serial ranges within one nature of document, starting at 1.
derivation_notes.gstr1.net_issue: net_issue = Total Number - Cancelled, computed by the tool rather than entered by the filer.

notes.text: This table has no money in it at all: no rate, no taxable value, no tax. It reports how many documents of each kind were issued and how many were cancelled, and is mandatory in every GSTR-1 regardless of what else the filer reports.

doc_num is positional. It is the index of the nature of document in a fixed twelve-entry list, so the list's order is part of the payload contract — reordering the master would silently relabel every row.

The serial-number pattern requires at least one character that is not a zero or a separator, so ranges like '0' or '00/00' are rejected while 'A0' and '0A1' are accepted. Nothing checks that 'Sr. No. To' actually follows 'Sr. No. From', nor that Total Number matches the size of the range — a range of A1 to A100 may legitimately declare any count.

Total Number and Cancelled accept digits only, with no decimal point and no sign, and the reference reads them with parseFloat rather than an integer parse. net_issue is derived, so a filer cannot state a net figure that contradicts the other two.

Records sit at the top level of the section payload and are wrapped by the upload envelope under doc_issue.doc_det. Several serial ranges for one nature of document collapse into one record with several entries.
GSTN's shipped sample CSV for this table is malformed: its rows run together on a single line without line breaks, so it cannot be parsed as CSV at all. Layout reference only.

Two ranges of the same document nature may start at the same serial number. The reference keys each entry on a num it mints itself (`matchedInv.docs.length + 1`, returnStructure.js:8780, matched on that num at offline.js:10614), so a collision on the serial range is impossible there — nothing about the 'Sr. No. From' column identifies a row. Treating a repeated start number as a duplicate rejected the second range and lost it.
